services.name: Summer Session
services.desc: Thanks for joining us for Summer Session 2026! Stay tuned for updates on next year’s camps and intensives. Get inspired this summer with some of the best arts educators in the province at our state-of-the-art Granville Island (GI) hub and Surrey Centre location. Choose from morning, afternoon, and full-day programs. Lunch supervision is also available for students aged 6 to 12 enrolled in full-day programs and available as an add-on for half-day programs.
